name: mail
description: Represents email or message composition. On hover, the envelope flap lifts upward (morphing from a flat top to a peak 5 units above the rim), revealing the open interior. Closes on hover-leave.

animation.description: Two paths share identical command structures allowing smooth browser interpolation. The outline flap peak morphs L12,5→L12,0 (0.35s, cubic-bezier 0.65/0/0.35/1). The inner crease morphs from outer envelope corners inward simultaneously. Reverses on hover-leave. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: When used as a link to an inbox or compose flow, the parent element should provide destination context.
